# tidygenclust

`tidygenclust` provides functions and methods to run genetic clustering
in R, and to align and compare multiple runs of the same or different K.
`tidygenclust` builds on `tidypopgen`, enhancing the grammar of
population genetics with a focus on genetic clustering.

Its core functionality is provided by native R and C++ code:

- [`gt_radmix()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/tidygenclust/dev/reference/gt_radmix.md)
  to estimate ancestry proportions with the method of ADMIXTURE
  (Alexander et al. 2009). It is a heavily optimized, multithreaded C++
  implementation of the algorithm of ADMIXTURE (block relaxation with
  quasi-Newton acceleration), which works directly on a `gen_tibble`,
  supports pseudohaploid data, and includes the cross-validation of
  ADMIXTURE to choose K (Alexander & Lange 2011). Its code started as a
  port of
  [OpenADMIXTURE.jl](https://github.com/OpenMendel/OpenADMIXTURE.jl) (Ko
  et al. 2023) and has since been extensively rewritten; its optional
  SVD start adapts the alternating least squares of
  [ADAMIXTURE](https://github.com/AI-sandbox/ADAMIXTURE);
- [`gt_clumppling()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/tidygenclust/dev/reference/gt_clumppling.md)
  to align multiple clustering runs within and across K with the method
  of clumppling (Liu, Kopelman & Rosenberg 2024), ported to R and C++,
  with modifications, from the python package
  [clumppling](https://github.com/PopGenClustering/Clumppling).

Optionally, on Linux, `tidygenclust` can also run the python packages
[fastmixture](https://github.com/Rosemeis/fastmixture)
([`gt_fastmixture()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/tidygenclust/dev/reference/gt_fastmixture.md))
and [ADAMIXTURE](https://github.com/AI-sandbox/ADAMIXTURE)
([`gt_adamixture()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/tidygenclust/dev/reference/gt_adamixture.md)),
and the original ADMIXTURE program
([`tidypopgen::gt_admixture()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/tidypopgen/reference/gt_admixture.html)),
which it installs in a conda environment on request.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `tidygenclust` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("EvolEcolGroup/tidygenclust")
```

[`gt_radmix()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/tidygenclust/dev/reference/gt_radmix.md)
and
[`gt_clumppling()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/tidygenclust/dev/reference/gt_clumppling.md)
work straight away. The optional tools (`fastmixture`, ADMIXTURE and
ADAMIXTURE) are installed with `reticulate` in a conda environment,
`ctidygenclust`, when you ask for them (this only works on Linux at the
moment: on Windows, you can use them through the WSL; on macOS, they are
not available, as their OpenMP library conflicts with that of R).

## Overview of functionality

An overview of the functionality of `tidygenclust` and its integration
with `tidypopgen` is provided in the “Get Started” vignette. This also
includes a detailed description of how to align multiple runs of
clustering and compare them. There are also several articles in the
“Articles” section of the website of the package:

1.  Benchmarking
    [`gt_radmix()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/tidygenclust/dev/reference/gt_radmix.md)
    against ADMIXTURE, fastmixture and ADAMIXTURE.

2.  Benchmarking
    [`gt_clumppling()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/tidygenclust/dev/reference/gt_clumppling.md)
    against the python clumppling.

3.  Installing and running external tools.

4.  An illustration of how treating pseudohaploids as if they were
    diploids can bias the results of clustering (and how
    [`gt_radmix()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/tidygenclust/dev/reference/gt_radmix.md)
    can handle pseudohaploids correctly).

The [website](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/tidygenclust/) documents
the version on the `main` branch; the documentation of the development
version, on the `dev` branch, is at
<https://evolecolgroup.github.io/tidygenclust/dev/>.

## References

Alexander DH, Novembre J, Lange K (2009) Fast model-based estimation of
ancestry in unrelated individuals. Genome Research, 19(9), 1655-1664.

Alexander DH, Lange K (2011) Enhancements to the ADMIXTURE algorithm for
individual ancestry estimation. BMC Bioinformatics, 12, 246.

Ko S, Chu BB, Peterson D, Okenwa C, Papp JC, Alexander DH, Sobel EM,
Zhou H, Lange KL (2023) Unsupervised discovery of ancestry-informative
markers and genetic admixture proportions in biobank-scale datasets. The
American Journal of Human Genetics, 110(2), 314-325.

Liu X, Kopelman NM, Rosenberg NA (2024) Clumppling: cluster matching and
permutation program with integer linear programming. Bioinformatics,
40(1), btad751.

# Package index

## ADMIXTURE and clumppling

Native estimation of ancestry proportions with the ADMIXTURE method, and
alignment of runs across K with clumppling, with their plotting
functions.

- [`gt_radmix()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/tidygenclust/dev/reference/gt_radmix.md)
  : Estimate ancestry proportions with the ADMIXTURE method

- [`gt_clumppling()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/tidygenclust/dev/reference/gt_clumppling.md)
  : Run clumppling

- [`subset_gt_clumppling()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/tidygenclust/dev/reference/subset_gt_clumppling.md)
  :

  Subset a `gt_clumppling` object

- [`tidy(`*`<gt_clumppling>`*`)`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/tidygenclust/dev/reference/tidy_gt_clumppling.md)
  :

  Tidy a `gt_clumppling` object

- [`autoplot(`*`<gt_clumppling>`*`)`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/tidygenclust/dev/reference/autoplot_gt_clumppling.md)
  : autoplot for clumppling objects

## External tools

Optional tools, installed in the conda environment `ctidygenclust`
(Linux only).

### Managing the tools

- [`tgc_tools_install()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/tidygenclust/dev/reference/tgc_tools_install.md)
  :

  Install optional tools for `tidygenclust`

- [`tgc_tools_version()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/tidygenclust/dev/reference/tgc_tools_version.md)
  :

  Print version of the optional tools installed by `tidygenclust`

### fastmixture

- [`tgc_fastmixture_install()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/tidygenclust/dev/reference/tgc_fastmixture_install.md)
  :

  Add `fastmixture` to the conda environment of `tidygenclust`

- [`gt_fastmixture()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/tidygenclust/dev/reference/gt_fastmixture.md)
  : fastmixture algorithm for population genetics clustering

### ADAMIXTURE

- [`tgc_adamixture_install()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/tidygenclust/dev/reference/tgc_adamixture_install.md)
  :

  Add `ADAMIXTURE` to the conda environment of `tidygenclust`

- [`gt_adamixture()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/tidygenclust/dev/reference/gt_adamixture.md)
  : ADAMIXTURE algorithm for population genetics clustering

### ADMIXTURE

The ADMIXTURE binary is run by
[`tidypopgen::gt_admixture()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/tidypopgen/reference/gt_admixture.html).

- [`tgc_admixture_install()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/tidygenclust/dev/reference/tgc_admixture_install.md)
  :

  Add `ADMIXTURE` to the conda environment of `tidygenclust`

## Example data

- [`capeverde_pops`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/tidygenclust/dev/reference/capeverde_pops.md)
  : Population membership for the Capeverde dataset
